description:
Watch the official teaser trailer for Vought Rising, the upcoming The Boys prequel series from Prime Video. Set in 1950s New York, the series explores the early days of Vought, the origins of Compound V, and a twisted murder mystery centered around Soldier Boy and Clara Vought, also known as Stormfront.

The series stars Jensen Ackles as Soldier Boy and Aya Cash as Clara Vought / Stormfront, with Mason Dye as Bombsight, plus KiKi Layne, Jorden Myrie, Brian J. Smith and more. Vought Rising premieres on Prime Video in 2027.
